classification.difficultyReason: Identify the relevant marked parallel lines and transversals, then sequence alternate or co-interior angle facts with triangle sums or exterior angles across connected regions.

content.prompt: Find $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$ and $\theta$ in the following diagrams, giving reasons.

spec.description: Triangle SOR; E, S and R are collinear. OH and ER carry matching parallel arrows. Ordinary source-blue marks are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: Angle HOS is 35 degrees, SRO is 70 degrees; SOR is alpha and OSR is theta.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels.

answer.worked:
$\theta=35^\circ$ (alternate angles, $HO\parallel ER$).

$$\begin{align*}\alpha+35^\circ+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=75^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle SOR$.

spec.description: Triangle AIR with collinear VIRT and LAU; the two sloping lines have matching parallel marks.
spec.mathematics: Exterior angle VIA is 115 degrees, IAR is 75 degrees, ARI is theta and RAU is beta.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}75^\circ+\theta&=115^\circ\\\theta&=40^\circ\end{align*}$$
Exterior angle of $\triangle AIR$.

$\beta=40^\circ$ (alternate angles, $UL\parallel RI$).

spec.description: Parallelogram CARD with diagonal AD; distinct single and double parallel marks.
spec.mathematics: CAD=25 degrees, CDA=55 degrees; DAR=alpha, ADR=beta, ARD=gamma.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=55^\circ$ (alternate angles, $RA\parallel DC$).

$\beta=25^\circ$ (alternate angles, $CA\parallel DR$).

$$\begin{align*}\gamma+55^\circ+25^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=100^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle ADR$.

spec.description: Parallelogram PLAY with diagonal PA and two distinct pairs of parallel marks.
spec.mathematics: PLA=70 degrees, YAP=50 degrees; LPA=alpha, APY=beta, PAL=gamma.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=50^\circ$ (alternate angles, $PL\parallel YA$).

$$\begin{align*}\alpha+\beta+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\50^\circ+\beta+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\\beta&=60^\circ\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles, $PY\parallel LA$.

$\gamma=60^\circ$ (alternate angles, $PY\parallel LA$).

spec.description: Quadrilateral TRAP, diagonal PR, parallel TR and PA, right angle at T.
spec.mathematics: TRP=32 degrees, RAP=48 degrees; RPA=alpha, TPR=beta, PRA=gamma.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=32^\circ$ (alternate angles, $PA\parallel TR$).

$$\begin{align*}\beta+90^\circ+32^\circ&=180^\circ\\\beta&=58^\circ\\\gamma+32^\circ+48^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=100^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sums of $\triangle TRP$ and $\triangle ARP$, respectively.

spec.description: Quadrilateral FGHI with diagonal FH and parallel FI and GH.
spec.mathematics: GFH=65 degrees, FGH=70 degrees, FIH=115 degrees; IFH=alpha, FHG=beta, IHF=gamma.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\beta+65^\circ+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\\beta&=45^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle FGH$.

$\alpha=45^\circ$ (alternate angles, $IF\parallel HG$).

$$\begin{align*}\gamma+45^\circ+115^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=20^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle FHI$.

spec.description: Crossed triangles FWG and TWI; FWI and GWT are straight lines; FG and TI have matching parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: FGW=40 degrees, GWI=95 degrees; GFW=alpha, TIW=beta, WTI=gamma.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\alpha+40^\circ&=95^\circ\\\alpha&=55^\circ\end{align*}$$
Exterior angle of $\triangle FGW$.

$\beta=55^\circ$ and $\gamma=40^\circ$ (alternate angles, $FG\parallel TI$).

spec.description: Crossed triangles SMA and TRA; SAT and MAR are straight lines; SM and RT have matching parallel arrows. Alpha occupies the upper angle at A.
spec.mathematics: SMA=65 degrees, SAM=30 degrees; SAR=alpha, ART=beta, RTA=gamma.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\alpha+30^\circ&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=150^\circ\end{align*}$$
Straight angle at $A$.

$\beta=65^\circ$ (alternate angles, $MS\parallel TR$).

$$\begin{align*}\beta+\gamma&=\alpha\\65^\circ+\gamma&=150^\circ\\\gamma&=85^\circ\end{align*}$$
Exterior angle of $\triangle ART$.
